The '''Cranan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]] controlled by the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]].

==Behin the scenes==
[[Daniel Wallace]] identified the Cranan system as the system where [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] fought off [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] who attacked [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] ship on page 100 of the ''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''.<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|danwallace|153|Unstated Canon in Star Wars: The Essential Atlas}}</ref>
